mechanics.name: Flame Breath
mechanics.note: Cone of fire out of her head. Only the tank should ever be standing in front of her.

mechanics.name: Wing Buffet
mechanics.note: Knocks everyone in front of her back and sheds threat. The tank takes it; anybody else in the cone was in the tank's spot.

mechanics.name: Tail Sweep
mechanics.note: Cone behind her, flinging whoever is in it towards the whelp caves. Nobody has a reason to be behind her tail.

mechanics.name: Fireball
mechanics.note: Thrown at a patch of floor while she is airborne; it burns the spot, so move off it.
